body:
Real, general per-instance white-label branding (app_name/tagline/colors/logo)
behind GET (public)/PUT (branding.admin) /api/v1/branding -- console.html now
reads this at load instead of hardcoding CarePyre. CarePyre's own branding is
now live-configured through the API, not a schema special case.

Also real storage for the "this call may be recorded" consent-announcement
audio (compliance.recording.manage GET/PUT /api/v1/compliance/recording) --
closes CAREPYRE-9311's own named gap. console.html gained a browser-mic
recording panel (MediaRecorder) to produce it self-service.

New CarePyre/android-admin/ Gradle module: a real, minimal white-label
Android app (WebView wrapper, "generic"/"carepyre" product flavors, same
code). Source-complete; not build-verified (no Android SDK in this sandbox).

7 new Go tests, all passing. go build/vet/test clean. Live-verified against
running idunapro.service.

Commits: IDUNA_PRO 185c74a, CarePyre f5a27d5.

⚓ ☃
title: White-label branding + compliance-recording (CP-WHITELABEL-1, CP-COMPLIANCE-REC-1) + CarePyre admin Android app
